notes: Home Depot data read from homedepot.com product pages (server-rendered __APOLLO_STATE__), with the page localized to store #4301 Sioux Falls via the THD_LOCALIZER cookie. The embedded price object is keyed to storeId 8119 (HD's online store), so the prices are homedepot.com online prices. All 12 HD items have availabilityType 'Online' (ship-to-home/ship-to-store, not stocked on the shelf at #4301). Local in-store stock was not confirmed.

Home Depot sizes come from the listing's 'Panel length' and the larger of its 'Panel Width/Height' fields, converted to mm. Weight is the listing's 'Panel weight', which looks like a per-panel value. Watts is per panel; total kit watts = watts x panels for panel packs.

Home Depot sells no grid-tie microinverters (searches for Enphase, APsystems and 'microinverter' returned none) and no IronRidge, Unirac or SnapNrack PV racking (the 'IronRidge' brand at HD is landscape edging). Its roof mounts are RV/small-panel Z-brackets and tilt mounts.

Menards: menards.com returns HTTP 403 to scripted and WebFetch requests, so no Menards page was read. All Menards entries come from web-search snippets and summaries of menards.com listings. Their prices are list prices from cached snippets, some with expired 11% mail-in rebates, and should be re-checked. The ids use Menards' URL product id (p-<id>), not the 7-digit Menards SKU, which could not be read. Availability at Sioux Falls West #3064 is unknown; the Solar Panel Kit Direct kits appear to be vendor-shipped special-order items.

Menards' residential-grade modules (Thornova 440 W bifacial, Phono Solar PS400M1H-24/TH 400 W) and its SMA string inverters appear only inside the Solar Panel Kit Direct kits. No standalone listing was found, so they have no panel or inverter entries. Some snippet spec tables contradict the kit descriptions (e.g. 6 kW: 16 vs 22 panels; 7 kW: 28 x 280 W). Menards also lists 3/5/6/7/8/10 kW ground-mount versions (the ground-mount racking excludes the 2-3 in. pipe substructure) and 9/15/20 kW flush-mount versions.
Not included: HD Nature Power 50262 '330-Watt' panel (the listing says 2 panels at 58 x 27 in, which is inconsistent with 330 W per panel), portable/foldable panels, and Ring/trickle-charger panels.

homedepot-4301.install_service: 'Solar Panel Installation' (homedepot.com/services/c/solar-panel-installation/3e382af82): a free in-home energy consultation, then a custom system installed by a local licensed partner. The page's lead form says 'Redirecting to our service provider Sunrun...', so Sunrun is the current provider. Sunrun's state list (sunrun.com/utility) does not include South Dakota (it lists CA, CT, DC, FL, HI, IL, MA, MD, NH, NJ, NV, NY, RI, TX), so the service very likely does not cover Sioux Falls. This was not confirmed with a ZIP-code check (the form shows 'This service isn't available in your area' for uncovered ZIPs). HD also lists an 'Off Grid Solar System Assembly' service.
